thread:
emily.k: Heads-up — deploybot just skipped the publish for build 2026.03.14 due to a provenance mismatch when pushing to ECR. saw the alert in #eng-infra too :grimacing:
ollie: ugh, any details from the deploy logs? link?
releasebot: [deploybot] publish attempt failed: registry returned non-fatal provenance error. image push aborted. see logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/2026-03-14/2026.03.14-20260314-42
emily.k: pasted the tail of the log below:
```
INFO  publish: starting upload for service/api:2026.03.14
ERROR provenance: attestation digest mismatch (expected sha256:ab12..., got sha256:ff34...)
WARN  publish: aborting push, leaving temp tag service/api:2026.03.14-temp
INFO  registry: notified owner team via webhook
```
sam.h: Is this the cross-account mirror step? We recently enabled regional mirroring for eu-west-1, could be a duplicate layer ordering issue.
mia: If the digest doesn't match, we should avoid force-promoting. But also can't block the canary window. Thoughts on manual promote vs rollback? :thinking_face:
ellie: Can we retag to the pinned digest we know is good? I can run a quick `skopeo inspect` if someone gives me the digest.
oncall-sre: pinging infra oncall to confirm no broader replication issues. @infra-oncall please advise.
deploy-bot: automated note: replica-check failed for eu-regional-mirror-03, queuing retry in 10m. (reaction :hourglass_flowing_sand:)
emily.k: Proposed plan: 1) do NOT manually promote the temp tag. 2) pin the service-canary job to the last-known-good digest (sha256:ab12...) for the 1-hour canary window. 3) trigger a fresh build with provenance attestation offload to debug. 4) update release notes with the hold and customer-facing blurb.
sam.h: +1 to pinning. I'll open a quick PR to the rollout config to pin digest for the canary job and start the canary manually.
mia: If pinning is quick we can keep the canary live; if not, we should abort canary and roll back the previous stable release. prefer to avoid unexpected behavior in prod.
ellie: PR up: https://git.internal/redwood/deploy/compare/pin-canary-20260314 — anyone able to approve?
oncall-sre: infra confirmed regional mirror flapped during the push window, looks like transient. they recommend retrying push after mirror stabilizes, but do not auto-promote.
emily.k: thanks. I'll update the release notes and add a short incident note: "Canary hold: image publish skipped due to provenance digest mismatch; pinning to prior digest for 1-hour canary while infra investigates."
sam.h: approved and merged. starting canary with pinned digest now. monitor dashboards and set a 30m rollback timer. :eyes:
mia: Copy — if anything odd, rollback to stable v2026.02.28 and notify customers on status page.
emily.k: I'll also run `cosign verify` against the failed artifact and upload the attestation blob to the ticket for SRE/infra triage.
ellie: FYI I've deleted the temp tag to avoid accidental promote: `aws ecr batch-delete-image --repository-name service/api --image-ids imageTag=2026.03.14-temp`
emily.k: good call. keeping this thread as the release coordination log. tagging the release notes PR with link to the incident ticket. thanks everyone. :shipit:
